dataset_name: Patna Urban Crime and Women Safety Index
data_sources: National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) - Crime in India (Metropolitan Cities)
Patna Police Thana Jurisdictions & Law-and-Order Zones
OpenStreetMap (OSM) Night Streetlight & Police Station Proximity Proxies

danapur cantonment.women_safety_rating: High (Secure, restricted access, low harassment history)
danapur cantonment.notes: Excellent security environment near Cantonment and Saguna More.

bailey road / saguna more.crime_rate_index: Low (Major arterial highway, continuous PCR van patrols)
bailey road / saguna more.women_safety_rating: High (Well-lit, wide roads, 24x7 traffic, CCTV coverage)
bailey road / saguna more.notes: Prime family and working women residential corridor.

rps more / canal road.crime_rate_index: Low (Gated residential apartments, high CCTV concentration)
rps more / canal road.notes: Highly sought after for young families and college students.

boring road / sk puri.crime_rate_index: Low to Moderate (Commercial petty theft, chain snatching)
boring road / sk puri.women_safety_rating: High (Active student/commercial hub, well-lit till late night)
boring road / sk puri.notes: Safe social ecosystem for women; major drawback is waterlogging.

patliputra colony.crime_rate_index: Low (Gated residential cooperative society, night guards)
patliputra colony.notes: Historically prestigious and secure colony; moderate stormwater issues.

digha / kurji.crime_rate_index: Moderate (Rapid peri-urban growth, sporadic property disputes)
digha / kurji.women_safety_rating: Moderate to High (Well-connected via JP Ganga Path)
digha / kurji.notes: Near riverfront levee; good elevation, developing residential infrastructure.

gardanibagh / anishabad.crime_rate_index: Low to Moderate (Government quarters zone, organized grid)
gardanibagh / anishabad.notes: Good law-and-order presence; moderate waterlogging during extreme cloudbursts.

phulwari sharif.women_safety_rating: Moderate (Active daylight commerce, narrow interior lanes)
phulwari sharif.notes: Close to AIIMS Patna; high density, variable infrastructure.

gandhi maidan / ashok rajpath.crime_rate_index: Moderate (Heavy congestion, pickpocketing, dense market zone)
gandhi maidan / ashok rajpath.women_safety_rating: Moderate (Crowded market, requires situational awareness at night)
gandhi maidan / ashok rajpath.notes: High police presence but very crowded and commercial.

kankarbagh colony.crime_rate_index: Moderate (High density, vehicle theft, residential burglary)
kankarbagh colony.women_safety_rating: Moderate to Safe in central blocks; isolated pockets in south bypass
kankarbagh colony.notes: Moderate social safety; major risk remains chronic 1-2m waterlogging.

rajendra nagar.crime_rate_index: Moderate (Dense old town colonies, petty theft)
rajendra nagar.women_safety_rating: Moderate (Safe interior colonies during day, deserted during floods)
rajendra nagar.notes: Social safety acceptable, but extreme flood vulnerability makes it high risk.

patna bypass / transport nagar.crime_rate_index: High (Isolated heavy vehicle corridor, highway robberies)
patna bypass / transport nagar.women_safety_rating: Low (Poor street lighting, deserted stretches at night)
